rites.name: Eluannys
rites.text: Eluannys is a vow-sworn chaos-weaver of the Nuimiel powers, who bends primordial disorder into the edge of a blade. Her strikes unleash one of six elemental unravelings, and her voice can reach the minds of wild beasts for ten minutes at a time.

rites.name: Silaerleth
rites.text: Silaerleth is a concept of primordial chaos carried by a single blessing, a force that turns each strike into a fracture of the world's old order. It is a rare seam in the Nuimiel Arcane age E1, where the first sparks of creation still hum beneath the surface.

rites.name: Elaeniel
rites.text: Elaeniel is the first of the Verdant Tongues, a concept of attunement in which the living world's older currents are read as speech. Those who learn its cadence can hear the murmured accounts of creatures wandering the hills and marshes of Nuimiel, drawing out whatever those beasts have seen or sensed in the last day.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is the concept of the first sounding that condensed the roots of Nuimiel, a note held so long it became the ground under the world. Scholars of the Holy Age taught that every temple flame keeps a fragment of it alive.

rites.name: Jorostath
rites.text: Jorostath is the concept of Nuimiel's power to bind and unbind, a sounding that gathers loose matter into roots during the Singing. In the Age of Sundering, it is said to have torn old bonds apart when landfall shook the world.

rites.name: Bruldon
rites.text: Bruldon is the concept of a binding oath sworn before the council of Nuimiel, a vow held in the Courts that could hold a door shut against the hungry tides beyond. It was the first principle taught in the temples of the Holy Age, where flame was lit to witness each promise.

rites.name: Kraktaithun
rites.text: Kraktaithun is the concept of the Gate-Oath, the binding promise that held the doors between worlds shut until the Age of Sundering. In the Courts it was argued over by councils of trial-bearers, and when landfall broke the old bonds its meaning split into many competing doctrines.

rites.name: Ryelys
rites.text: In the multiverse of Elysium, Ryelys, the Luminary, is a sentient nexus of cosmic energy, born from the convergence of realities. It exists to empower and inspire, fostering unity and hope across dimensions.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a sworn wild-guardian of the Nuimiel realm who takes the oath before the untamed land itself, rejecting every decree that would fence a meadow or dam a river. Her oath binds her to shield free growth and open horizons against the surveyors and tyrants who would map and master them.

rites.name: Elaelinys
rites.text: Elaelinys is a concept-born oath of the Nuimiel Arcane realm, a vow of unbinding that lets its swearers wield verses taken from wild sympathies and living growth. Its teachings say the oath grows strongest when the swearer's allies are sworn to the same ceiling of freedom. Those who keep it are said to call up the green hosts of the old forests whenever their vow is tested.

rites.name: Orierlimae
rites.text: Orierlimae is a ward-song of the Nuimiel arcane schools, a resonance that lets its bearer and allies tread any broken ground as though it were smooth stone. In the later ages the song swells to thirty feet, carrying its calm across whole battlefields and ruined passes.

rites.name: Ryilliona
rites.text: Ryilliona is a quicksilver duelist-saint of the Nuimiel Arcane age, whose footwork is said to fold the space between strides. In the sixth era she could turn a sprint into a second blow before the first had landed, a technique that became the foundation of the Silvered Stride schools.

rites.name: Elinora
rites.text: Elinora is a concept of arcane sovereignty in the Nuimiel omniverse, a mantle an adept may wear to shed every chain and bind of the world for a single minute. Under its authority the wearer soars, passes through stone and flesh alike, and pierces any ward that would stop lesser strikes.

rites.name: Oriiraeleth
rites.text: Oriiraeleth is an oath-bound order of wandering champions in Nuimiel who take up the cause of disorder for its own sake, owing no allegiance to lawful or wicked causes. Their sworn blades are said to sense the rigid machines and bound elementals of the world and to strike them with a particular fury. The order's founders forged its vow in the aftermath of a great tyrant's fall.

rites.name: Nuellanae
rites.text: Nuellanae is a loose tradition of spellcraft in which a summoner binds a companion from the wild rather than from the outer planes. Practitioners who work this way gain animals that carry a faint resonance of the forest and river, though their power rarely rivals that of the more storied bindings.

rites.name: Silinnys
rites.text: Silinnys is a dormant sensory discipline of the Arcane realm in the Nuimiel omniverse, practiced by wandering oracles of the sixth era who attune their perception to the hum of bound matter. Its practitioners claim it reveals animated lattices, cinder-born wraiths, and storm-spirits that drift between the ley-currents of the age. Though rarely taught, it remains a closely guarded inheritance of the third generation of practitioners.

rites.name: Eleinwen
rites.text: Eleinwen is a sigil-craft in the Nuimiel omniverse that redirects a warded strike toward hardened wills rather than corrupted things. Its practitioners in the third age of the sixth era learned to aim the rebuke at stone-hearted automata and bound fire-spirits instead of the restless dead.

rites.name: Orielirlae
rites.text: Orielirlae is a dreamknight of the Arcane realm who was born into poverty and now carries a gentle light through the forgotten corners of Nuimiel. Hungry children, beasts, and outcasts all find in Orielirlae a companion who asks nothing back and gives comfort freely.

rites.name: Venuarlina
rites.text: Venuarlina is a hushed, cloud-borne concept of the Arcane realm, a choir of soft lanterns that drift above sleeping villages. Its gentle hymns knit scattered strength back into tired travelers and warm them with borrowed breath. Its ceiling is set low because it wounds nothing and mends only what the living already carry.

rites.name: Alaamineth
rites.text: Alaamineth is a rite of the Verdant Choir, in which an initiate sings to the living roots beneath the soil to borrow the perceptions of a single creature. For a span of ten minutes the chosen beast becomes a tongue through which its memories of the last day and the wild around it may be read aloud. Its knowledge is shallow and its words few, yet the rite has guided many a traveller away from unseen hunger.

rites.name: Alaeleth
rites.text: Alaeleth is a concept of solidarity-born hope in the arcane realm of Nuimiel, an aura that lets those gathered near a single standing ally refuse to fall into final silence. Its reach widens as the bond between companions deepens over the long years of the era.

rites.name: Venelleth
rites.text: Venelleth is a sustained tempest-dancer of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a concept of endurance that outlasts any weariness laid upon it. In the third age of the sixth era it stands as a living bulwark that no enchantment can lull or slow.

rites.name: Silionnora
rites.text: Silionnora is a radiant concept in the Nuimiel universe, a regal presence that blazes with sunlight-bright glory and turns hostile hearts toward devotion. Its era is E6, and it has existed for three ages, though it manifests only briefly at the height of its power. Its light and majesty can awe a battlefield into stillness and feed weary allies with a sudden feast.

rites.name: Ilyelionnys
rites.text: Ilyelionnys is a blade-shaped vow-engine forged from the sworn devotion of a Lovebird knight, humming whenever its bearer's heart stays true to a beloved. Its single great act was a sustained ward that held back a collapsing sky-bridge over a river gorge for three days.

rites.name: Ilyaniriel
rites.text: Ilyaniriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Nuimiel, a voice that carries a lover's name across the valleys of the Vesh. When spoken with full devotion, the name rolls outward as a shockwave that shakes the ground beneath those who hear it and steadies the speaker's own breath.

rites.name: Ryena
rites.text: Ryena is a silver-threaded ward-prayer of the Nuimiel Concord, sung by mind-keepers when a companion's will begins to slip under a stranger's glamour. The chant is said to fold a second breath of resolve over the wavering soul, granting it a fresh chance to break free.

rites.name: Lyiruarla
rites.text: Lyiruarla is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nuimiel omniverse, a radiant grace that is kindled when a bearer chooses to spend their own vitality for others. Its aura gathers the living around it and redistributes that bright sacrifice as restoration, though the hollow dead and the made-things turn away from its warmth.

rites.name: Elerlys
rites.text: Elerlys is a quiet doctrine of the Nuimiel arcane schools, holding that a bond kept without deceit cannot be bent by any charm laid upon the heart. Adepts who reach its inner rank discover they may refuse any enchantment at will, though refusal leaves their own sworn affections exposed to the same wind.

rites.name: Sileira
rites.text: Sileira is a concept of Nuimiel's Arcane realm, a heart-fire that a bearer may kindle at the height of their mastery to stand forward as the lightning rod of a battle. For a single minute the bearer's chest blazes with light that bathes the field, pulling the hostile gaze and blunting every blow aimed at allies.

rites.name: Ryireth
rites.text: Ryireth is a third-age arcane conduit within the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a crystalline lattice that draws stored power from the mana-veins beneath the continent of Sorrowglass. When its wardens call upon the lattice, it answers by unleashing a single carefully shaped surge of sorcery drawn from the deep reservoirs. The lattice does not forget what it gives, and each surge thins the veins for a generation.

rites.name: Elinnara
rites.text: Elinnara is a rebuking word of power spoken in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel during the sixth age, when the ley-tides grew unbalanced and the old titanic lords began to stir. Those who hear its syllables and fail to withstand their resonance are driven backward, unable to advance or strike until the sound fades or they are wounded.

rites.name: Oriilerwen
rites.text: Oriilerwen is a discipline of serene equilibrium in Nuimiel's Arcane realm, where an adept's presence dampens the violence of fortune for those nearby. While the adept stands conscious, the sharpest blows aimed at allies are softened into ordinary strikes, and in the adept's later years this quiet sphere widens to thirty feet.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a concept of inward stillness in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a state where a mind has drifted so far from worldly quarrels that no scrying or mental probe can find its emotions or truths. Its ambivalence is so complete that even the most careful reader of intent cannot tell whether its word is sincere.

rites.name: Lyimaerlae
rites.text: Lyimaerlae is an arcane concept in the Nuimiel omniverse, a silent mandate of balance that briefly forces the world to answer every blow with an equal reckoning. For a single minute the entity's presence turns the scales of conflict, rebounding harm and muting the advantages of its opponents. Its favor can be called only once before it must rest.

rites.name: Mienneth
rites.text: Mienneth is a ceremonial lattice of sealed glass in the Nuimiel cosmology, carried by oath-sworn wardens who channel their vows through its humming facets. Each warden's sigil brightens when a binding is sung, letting the bearer steady the threads of protective rites.

rites.name: Venaerlamys
rites.text: Venaerlamys is a sealed mental technique taught in the Arcane schools of Nuimiel, letting a practitioner sense the tread of great scaled wyrms, towering stone-bodied giants, and the restless dead across the land. Its third era of refinement made the practice common among wardens of the ruined frontier.

rites.name: Sileiniel
rites.text: Sileiniel is a concept of the Arcane realm, a sharpened vow that channels a warrior's will against the mightiest beasts and colossi of the Nuimiel omniverse. Its bearers can strike with a glow that unravels the thick hides of ancient wyrms and titanic giants. The concept is taught to martial orders in the third age of the era.

rites.name: Lyennaerora
rites.text: Lyennaerora is a mental ward-art of the Nuimiel Arcane realm, a stillness-discipline that lets a bearer who has faltered against a mind-binding or a crafty illusion draw breath and try the resistance again. Its reach is measured in the quiet of thought rather than in force, so its feats are small acts of recovery.

rites.name: Alaennys
rites.text: Alaennys is a quicksilver lattice of crystalline thought that a Nuimiel mind-artisan can awaken during the Sixth Era of its seventh age. Once roused, it hastens its wielder's cognition and reflexes so sharply that foes struggle to track or cut them down.

rites.name: Miiliel
rites.text: Miiliel is an arcane discipline in Nuimiel's sixth era, taught to wardens who have sworn to see a directive through to its end. Its practitioners cannot be slowed by sorcery, and neither can the companions standing close enough to share their resolve. Veterans of the discipline are said to cross a battlefield at full stride while hexes pile up uselessly behind them.

rites.name: Lyinora
rites.text: Lyinora is a concept of patient attention in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, where a missed strike sharpens the next one into a focused echo. Its scholars master tongues and crafts in half the usual time, letting learners carry skill across the age.

rites.name: Ryariolla
rites.text: Ryariolla is the perfected archetype of the clockwork automaton, a mechanism of such precise processes that it can overclock itself into a brief state of unyielding motion. For one minute it moves faster than any pursuer, cannot be pinned, dragged, or dazed, and strikes twice in a single motion before it must rest for a full cycle.

rites.name: Silalora
rites.text: Silalora is a concept of quiet, self-forged mental might, a discipline that teaches the will to outlast the flesh and the heart. Its practitioners cultivate telekinetic force through ritual and austerity, never through another's gift. Their strongest act is said to be a single focused thought that tears a fortress from its foundations.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a sustaining discipline in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, drawn from the old oath-weavers of the third age, who learned to braid their resolve into the flesh until a faltering vow could not unravel. Practitioners can call upon a surge of sacred will to hold a fragile working together at the very instant it threatens to collapse.

rites.name: Sileiriel
rites.text: Sileiriel is a concept of arcane discipline within the Nuimiel cosmos, a channeler who draws thought-force into the limbs to stretch past their natural bounds. For a single minute the practitioner's strikes reach a little further and can be reshaped into pure mental impact, slipping past partial shelter as though it were not there. The discipline ends at will or when consciousness fails.

rites.name: Elanwen
rites.text: Elanwen is a psychic sensing discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel during the E6 era, letting an adept perceive the drifting thoughts of nearby minds and rebuild their surroundings inside their own mind. Its wielders become aware of nearby creatures as though seeing them directly, and the reach of this awareness grows with mastery.

rites.name: Ilyinniel
rites.text: Ilyinniel is a concept of unbroken resolve, a reserve of stubborn will that a bearer can call upon the instant harm lands, dulling the blow before it can settle into flesh. It recharges only through the quiet hours of rest, so its wielders learn to spend it at the moment it matters most.

rites.name: Oriirleth
rites.text: Oriirleth is a concept of the Arcane realm's deepest mind-art, a surge of inner clarity that briefly makes its wielder unbreakable to psychic harm and unmoved by enchantment. For a single minute it lifts the bearer into the air and lets spells be woven without gesture or material, before fading and demanding a full day of rest to rekindle.

rites.name: Ilyirleth
rites.text: Ilyirleth is a radiant concept-being of the Arcane realm who lives by a vow of polished vitality, turning every battle into a stage where color and rhythm carry the day. Her presence is said to lift the spirits of entire districts, though her gaudy glow can also scorch those too sour to smile.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a concept of song-woven enchantment in the realm of Nuimiel, a chorus that drifts through halls of cold starlight. Those who listen to its unbroken hymn grow devoted, carrying its praise into every quiet conversation they later share.

rites.name: Veneriel
rites.text: Veneriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nuimiel omniverse, a discipline in which a wielder answers a blow with a burst of pigment that dazzles everything nearby. Its ink stains the ground for a short time, turning it treacherous before it dries into nothing.

rites.name: Oriimarliel
rites.text: Oriimarliel is a rhythm-born discipline in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, practiced by wandering dancers who turn footwork into a shield. Their motion so unsettles would-be strikers that any blow aimed at them or their allies while they stand conscious is hobbled before it lands. As mastery deepens, the dancers' influence widens to a broader circle of protection around them.

rites.name: Silamora
rites.text: Silamora is a resonance that binds the songs of the Nuimiel tides into a living instrument, its harmonics stored like coiled thunder in the marrow of the bells. In the seventh age of the Arcane realm, its bearers can hold sound as a shield and loose it as a flood that can shatter stone foundations.

rites.name: Lyanneilys
rites.text: Lyanneilys is a choir-bearing seraph of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, whose sustained hymn can compel hostile wills to lose their stride and dance in place. Each enemy may shake the enchantment loose at the close of its turn, and the hymn leaves a lasting resistance to charm in all allies nearby.

rites.name: Veninae
rites.text: Veninae is a concept-class power in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, born in the third age of the sixth era as a sworn bond between performers and their chosen champions. It lets a bearer turn personal charm and graceful motion into a defensive field that deflects harm without any heavy plating. Its wielders are known for drawing attention as a shield against danger.

rites.name: Lyelora
rites.text: Lyelora is a quiet doctrine of the Arcane realm in the third age of Nuimiel, taught in the low towers where wardens learn to stand unarmored yet shielded by presence alone. Those who master it turn their bearing and voice into a ward that deflects blows, and the discipline is said to hold even when a shield is raised.

rites.name: Mierlys
rites.text: In the Omniverse of Elysian Fields, the entity known as Mierlys, a Celestial Physician, is sworn to heal and protect life across the multiverse. A being of radiant energy, Mierlys traverses realms, combating illness and decay, and nurturing growth.

rites.name: Elaeliomwen
rites.text: Elaeliomwen is a tincture-sage of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, who distills restorative elixirs from moonlit petals during the cold hours before dawn. Her draughts can cure blindness, deafness, plague, paralysis, and venom, but each brew fades once she begins another or the sun completes its long circuit. She is said to have once steeped a brew strong enough to briefly mend a dying sun-field.

rites.name: Ryaneiliel
rites.text: Ryaneiliel is a concept-born ward of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a flicker of stabilizing light that answers the hurt of nearby allies by burning the wound clean. Where its gaze falls, injuries close and sickness recedes, and those who stand too close to the healed are scorched by the same brilliance.

rites.name: Venioniel
rites.text: Venioniel is a radiant sanctuary-force woven through the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a bloom of cleansing light that spreads outward from a single bearer. Those who stand within its glow are shielded from toxins and sickness that plague the lower planes of the era.

rites.name: Ilyala
rites.text: Ilyala is a concept of restorative mending drawn from the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, where the healing given by a devoted warden is echoed back as a brief shield of borrowed vitality. Its lore holds that a soul called back from the threshold needs less costly reagents, since the world itself remembers the passage.

rites.name: Ryillys
rites.text: Ryillys is the radiant purity-form that a Nuimiel arcane practitioner may assume once their mastery reaches its peak, when their will hardens into a body of searing light. For a minute the form cleanses the air around it of contagion and mends the nearby wounded, and it shrugs off blows from ordinary weapons. Its strength is spent quickly, so it may be called upon only once before a full rest is taken.

rites.name: Elaerina
rites.text: Elaerina is a Nuimiel concept of an oath-bound paladin order whose bearers defend the sovereignty of common people against tyrants. Her vow is renewed each cycle by a summit of bearers who vote on the tenets they swear to uphold.

rites.name: Orialaenae
rites.text: Orialaenae is a rallying hymn woven from the Arcane sigils of the Nuimiel realm, sung by those who refuse to stay kneeling. Its refrain stirs listeners within earshot to rise from the dirt and tear free of whatever holds them. In the E6 era it is said to have broken more chains than any blade.

rites.name: Miira
rites.text: Miira is a concept of collective resolve in Nuimiel, a rite where a single voice gathers the willing around it. Those who join the chorus of a cause can unmake the resolve of those who oppose it, leaving their minds bent toward the shared purpose.

rites.name: Oriilemae
rites.text: Oriilemae is a concept of unbowed will in the arcane realm of Nuimiel, an aura that keeps the bearer and nearby allies from being forced to the ground while they remain awake. Its reach grows with the bearer's mastery, until a whole battlefield can hold its ground under a hostile press.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a doctrine of the Arcane realm in Nuimiel, held by those who believe every living thing deserves the same freedom and breath. At the height of its discipline, a bearer's unwavering belief drags down any tyrant or giant who claims unfair standing, letting the bearer seize and topple even the largest foe.

rites.name: Siluanna
rites.text: Siluanna is a radiant liberator of the Nuimiel arcane realm, a figure whose stone-skinned flame burns away chains and fear for a single minute at a time. Her burning light marks the wardens who rally to her cause, and her presence steadies whole armies against the poisons and blades of tyrants.

rites.name: Elamwen
rites.text: Elamwen is a concept of a heroic transformation drawn from a sealed relic-blade, lasting only a minute before the glimmer fades. Those who carry its echo gain a mask-like presence and borrowed strength in struggle, and their gear swells to match.

rites.name: Ryemiriel
rites.text: Ryemiriel is a seventh-age arcane concept in Nuimiel, a discipline of the hidden hand in which a practitioner dampens their greatest sorceries into the posture of an ordinary tradesperson. Drawing on the quiet devotion of the Ossuary Choirs, the art lets a bearer hush the resonance of their power for an hour, moving unnoticed through courts and wards alike.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a quiet resonance that hums through the Arcane veils of Nuimiel, where a single bearer's steadiness becomes a tide lifting allies alongside them. Its wake grows wider as the bearer's will deepens, until the whole company moves as one heartbeat.

rites.name: Nuelionys
rites.text: Nuelionys is an arcane concept in the Nuimiel universe, a radiant bulwark of unbroken resolve that burns away gloom wherever it stands. Its light rallies allies with borrowed vigor while scorching foes with crackling brilliance. It is said to be the last flame kept by the Vesperine sages of the Ember Tides.

rites.name: Lyarluareth
rites.text: Lyarluareth is an arcane mode of transformation that lets a mortal swell to ten feet of height and blaze with a radius of bright light for one minute, after which the body must rest fully before the ritual can be spoken again. Its practitioners call it the brief crown of the mortal sky, and the Arcane realm of Nuimiel records it as a rare, costly grace.

rites.name: Miennys
rites.text: Miennys is an order of severe lawgiving knights who believe that without the walls of city and crown, all life sinks into chaos and stagnation. Their clergy, ranked from squire to grand hierophant, pushes civilization into the wild with unyielding discipline and sworn duty.

rites.name: Venaerlae
rites.text: Venaerlae is a silver-threaded ward-circle, sung into being by a warden of the Nuimiel Arcane Conclave, that wards a glade against the encroaching wild. Within its fifteen-foot bounds, allies strike with extra sanctified force and hostile things find the ground grown treacherous, while the ward whispers an alarm to its maker's sleeping mind.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is a sacred invocation that the Nuimiel powers sing through a warden's raised reliquary, the Ryerleth chant turning all rebellious wills away from the speaker. Its voice carries across an eight-state chord, and each warped creature that hears it is driven to flee the chanter's presence. Once again, the rite does not wound directly, but it reshapes the field around it.

rites.name: Eliniel
rites.text: Eliniel is a concept of ordered calm, a presence that unknots tangled minds and steadies the senses of those nearby across the Arcane realm of Nuimiel. In the third age of the sixth epoch, its radiance grows wider as its bearers grow in wisdom.

rites.name: Venimwen
rites.text: Venimwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nuimiel universe, a sustaining essence that lets a caster's own body be reinforced by the divine weave of their rituals. Its bearers gain a brief bulwark of vitality whenever they invoke a sacred working, and they find that officials of the ruling courts listen to them with unusual favor.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a concept of cosmic lawgiving in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, an inspiring avatar whose every step stamps the wild earth with the order of settled civilization. Its footfalls raise walls of fortified stone and bind allied hearts with a burning holy fire. In the sixth age its presence is remembered as the moment the land was claimed.

rites.name: Siliriolora
rites.text: Siliriolora is a lattice of silver-threaded oath-bindings that the sworn orders of Nuimiel weave around fraying laws, grown across the E6 age as a living ledger of promises. It answers the chaos of wild magic not with grand hatred but with patient, almost bureaucratic order, measuring every rupture against the vows it breaks.

rites.name: Miariolleth
rites.text: Miariolleth is a sensing discipline of the Arcane realm in Nuimiel, taught in the sixth age, that lets a practitioner feel the stirring of mind-bent wanderers, starlit wayfarers, and wild-veiled spirits gathered near a crossing. Its adepts are said to sharpen the sense by hearing the hum of long-forgotten wards, though few agree on what the hum truly is.

rites.name: Lyennalys
rites.text: Lyennalys is a ward-script of the Arcane realm's sixth era, inscribed on wayfarer's gauntlets to channel sanctified force against things that defy the ordered weave. Its bearers strike hardest against chaotic wild-born and bent-mind entities rather than the dead or the infernal.

rites.name: Nuareth
rites.text: Nuareth is a zealot-sculptor of Nuimiel's Arcane realm who forges pale rifles from the crystallized devotion of pilgrims. Each shot discharges a lance of hallowed fire, and the gun vanishes once its last round is spent or the forge-fires cool.

rites.name: Mielae
rites.text: Mielae is a sentient crossbow-spirit bound to the quiet hunters of the Nuimiel salt-marshes, who believes every projectile carries a tiny piece of intent. Its signature act is a bolt that bends the will of whatever it strikes, sending foes stumbling, fleeing, or dropping their grip. Among the gods of Nuimiel it is regarded as a minor but cunning patron of precision.

rites.name: Miarwen
rites.text: Miarwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, an echo of a lucky-charm power that lets a bearer seize a second chance when a foe falls or a blow lands true. Its strongest reach shows as a surge of resonant force that can topple a fortress-scale ward. Those who wield it are said to refill their reserves after every quiet rest.

rites.name: Alairleth
rites.text: Alairleth is a reflex-sharpening discipline taught in the Nuimiel arcane schools, where practitioners learn to read the world's tempo and answer before any rival can commit. Those who master it cannot be caught off guard while awake and seize initiative through force of presence. Its adepts are prized as duelists, bodyguards, and sentinels of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Nuarwen
rites.text: Nuarwen is an unnamed-face wanderer of the Arcane realm's frontier, a vigilante who rides between the scattered towns of the Nuimiel borderlands. When the hour turns against the weak, Nuarwen steps through the seams of perception and vanishes until the first blow is struck.

rites.name: Eluarlys
rites.text: Eluarlys is a lightning-conduction discipline of the Arcane realm in Nuimiel, taught in the sixth age to sword-bearers who learn to kindle a blade with a crackling sheath of storm-light for a short while. The flare lasts only a minute, yet it briefly stuns anyone it strikes, leaving foes unable to answer with a parry or counter until their next turn begins.

rites.name: Eliorlys
rites.text: Eliorlys is a lattice of resonant glyph-mantles worn by the scholars of Nuimiel's seventh age, each mantle humming with inherited cleverness. When its bearer calls upon the mantle's stored intellect, a brief storm of inspired reasoning floods every thought, lifting weak insight to a steady ceiling of brilliance.

rites.name: Venualeth
rites.text: Venualeth is a luminous guardian-spirit of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a slow-burning lantern of sheltering light that keeps allies from being frozen in place. Those who walk near it remain free to move even when the world around them turns to stone. Its radiance grows wider as it ages and its devotion deepens.

rites.name: Ilyennaleth
rites.text: Ilyennaleth is a lightning-bound ward that surfaces in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel during the sixth age, flaring whenever a foe's blade finds its wielder. Those who strike it are answered with a sharp crackle of stored storm, its strength set by the bearer's force of presence.

rites.name: Eliorimae
rites.text: Eliorimae is a steel-and-flesh champion of Nuimiel's Arcane realm, whose body swells into a towering frame that gleams with enchanted plate when the advocate of progress takes arms. Each transformation lasts a single minute before the champion must recover through a full rest, and the wounds of old wars are said to close more slowly with each cycle.

rites.name: Venallora
rites.text: Venallora is a cult of grave-singers in the highlands of Nuimiel, who call the restless dead out of the soil to serve as temporary laborers and sentries. Their summoned bone-wights carry no will of their own, dissolve after a single season's worth of minutes, and are never permitted to fight. The order teaches that obedience to the living is the only honest use of the departed.

rites.name: Ryelaereth
rites.text: Ryelaereth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Nuimiel omniverse, a third-age sigil-warden whose voice binds the clockwork and reanimated things that wander its era. Those who hear the warden's command within thirty paces are compelled to flee its presence until they are struck or the spell expires.

rites.name: Alaeniel
rites.text: Alaeniel is a warding sentinel-concept of the Arcane realm in Nuimiel's third age, a shimmering halo of ossuary-light that a bearer can wake or hush at will. Within its reach, the dead stay dead and sanctified script endures against any erasing hand, while approaching enemies find the ground itself reluctant to yield.

rites.name: Lyannys
rites.text: Lyannys is a concept of inherited memory held by the chroniclers of Nuimiel's Arcane realm, who can sense the history woven into any object they touch. Through this bond they read every script without study and never forget a name once heard, even across the long ages of the E6 era. Their touch can unveil the function of a relic in a single moment rather than through patient study.

rites.name: Eliorwen
rites.text: Eliorwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a rite of memory in which the restless dead of a bloodline are called up from the soil to stand guard around the caller. Those ancestral shades grant sight beyond walls and fend off any intruder who draws near, though the cost is a long recovery before the rite can be performed again.

rites.name: Venarla
rites.text: Venarla is a concept of ravenous flame drawn from the Arcane realm of Nuimiel, a corona that clings to its bearer and burns any intruder who dares to step within its shimmering haze. Each cycle of the third age it grows hungrier, consuming what it touches until the bearer releases it.

rites.name: Sileirlae
rites.text: Sileirlae is a sustaining ward-field in the arcane lore of Nuimiel, a shimmering halo of gentle force that travels with its bearer and steadies the spirits of allies within its reach. Those it shelters resist weariness and shrug off a measure of harm from blows and burns alike. It is treasured as a rite of guardianship rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Silaemeth
rites.text: Silaemeth is a dormant engine of the Arcane realm, a vast loom of crystallized inspiration that once spun the first melodies of Nuimiel. It wakes only when a mind offers it every ounce of creative fire, and it answers with a brief, terrible clarity.

rites.name: Oriennora
rites.text: Oriennora is a spell-woven sense of a settled land, awakened when a caster stands among streets and hearths. It flows outward for three miles, pressing the shape of roads, markers, and kin-bloods into the mind's eye.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is a shimmering arcane discipline that unravels otherworldly beings, dissolving fey, the restless dead, and creatures drawn from planes beyond the mortal world. Those it annihilates cannot knit themselves back together in any other realm, while lesser foes are merely struck by a crushing tide of force.

rites.name: Lyelwen
rites.text: Lyelwen is a sealed ecclesiastical writ of the Nuimiel powers, invoked by a priest against a fallen servant of the same faith, stripping that servant of every holy office and calling. A reinstated oath can be restored only through a rite of penance performed by one of the faithful.

rites.name: Silaeriel
rites.text: Silaeriel is a veil of sympathetic thread that binds two wayfarers of the Arcane realm, letting one bear the other's wounds by passing them through their own mind. Its binding lasts through the Nuimiel age of the third turning, and the bearer may sever it in an instant, releasing the pain as a shock upon the other.

rites.name: Elirenys
rites.text: Elirenys is a drifting aura of clean, cool air that a sorcerer of the Arcane realm of Nuimiel carries like a second skin, sweeping away storms and smothering gales wherever she walks. Its calm grows stronger the longer it is sustained, and in the Third Era it became the favoured shelter of wandering scholars crossing the tempest-torn Mireveld plains.

rites.name: Miennae
rites.text: Miennae is a brass bugle whose tune, played in the first light, rouses sleepers and lends tireless stamina to those who hear it, while at dusk its slow melody soothes weary soldiers into dreamless rest. Its sounds ride the bronze cadence of the dawn and dusk hours, and the instrument is said to have been forged by the first watchmen of Nuimiel.

rites.name: Silarlys
rites.text: Silarlys is a lattice of crackling lightning-threads woven by the Arcane realm's ninth-age artificers, binding itself to any blade that strikes a foe before its weave dissolves. Upon contact it discharges a jolt that locks the victim's muscles for a heartbeat longer than the storm can hold them.

rites.name: Venionaerae
rites.text: Venionaerae is a concept of arcane wording that lets a caster echo any minor incantation without its usual material or prerequisite burdens. It is a modest, reliable tool that never reaches beyond the small workings it copies.

rites.name: Elennarys
rites.text: Elennarys is a lattice of grave-marrow sigils that cling to a living frame and hum with borrowed endurance. Those who master it can steady a fallen ally with a surge of ghostly resilience that renews itself with every heartbeat of battle. Scholars of Nuimiel debate whether the strength is lent by the dead or merely remembered by the living.

rites.name: Venuariel
rites.text: Venuariel is a veil of luminous warding woven from the sleeping songs of the Nuimiel deep choirs, shaped into a shimmering shell that can gather up to five chosen beings within a shared circle of protection. Those cradled inside gain a subtle, deflecting sheen that turns aside blows for as long as the veil endures.

rites.name: Ryillaemeth
rites.text: Ryillaemeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Nuimiel, an awe-bearing presence that bends the minds of those who look upon it. Those who fail to resist its gaze fall to their knees and cannot rise until their own will reasserts itself.

rites.name: Sileinys
rites.text: Sileinys is a concept of Nuimiel's Arcane realm in the sixth era, a sealed word of command that a speaker of the third age can aim at one humanoid to bind its feet and loosen its grip. The binding is a quiet discipline rather than a force, and it breaks when the bound mind wins back its own composure.

rites.name: Ilovanum
rites.text: Ilovanum is a concept of the Three Futures in Nuimiel, the branching principle by which every possible ending is shelved in the Library during the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders. Its nature is to hold a single outcome open until a choosing hand closes it, so that where it is invoked, the other futures quietly fall silent.
